title: Vistazo
description: Vistazo adds quick visual insights and clean interaction tools for a faster, smoother Minecraft server experience.
body:
Vistazo is a lightweight visual information plugin for Minecraft servers that shows real-time block and entity data directly in the player’s HUD. When players look at a block or entity, Vistazo can display contextual information through the ActionBar, BossBar, Subtitle, or Chat, making it easy to inspect the world without opening menus or using complex commands.

The plugin is designed for performance-conscious servers and includes configurable update intervals, world filters, customizable display modes, and support for multiple language files. It can also show block hardness, estimated break time, entity health bars, and item drops when sneaking. In addition, Vistazo includes a recipe viewer that opens on sneak-right-clicking a block, letting players inspect crafting and furnace recipes in a clean and intuitive way.

Vistazo is ideal for survival, RPG, and custom servers that want a polished, fast, and non-intrusive way to present useful in-game information to players.

Commands:

vistazo or /vz - Toggle the HUD on or off for yourself.
/vistazo status - Show the current plugin status, including active profile, display mode, range, and refresh timing.
/vistazo reload - Reload the plugin configuration.
/vistazo profile <lobby|survival|minigames> - Apply a predefined optimization profile and reload the plugin settings.
Permissions:

vistazo.reload - Allows reloading the configuration.
vistazo.profile - Allows changing optimization profiles.
vistazo.recipe - Allows opening the recipe viewer by sneaking and right-clicking a block.
Main features:

Live block and entity information in the HUD
Multiple display channels: ActionBar, BossBar, Subtitle, or Chat
Configurable block and entity detection range
Block hardness and break-time display
Entity health bars
Sneak-based block drop preview
Recipe viewer for crafting and furnace recipes
Per-world enable and disable support
Multi-language support
Simple toggle command for players
Admin profile switching for different server modes
